snapshot_scope: Bounded public GitHub/CoAcademy evidence and one external web-reader observation; no private CoStead inspection or independent human study
intent: Make CoCivium useful and recoverable without dependence on one person, provider, site, device or unexplained terminology

semantics.PASS: Exact evidence supports the bounded named property only
semantics.PARTIAL: Some corroborated lower-stage evidence, but promotion needs further proof
semantics.FAIL_SCOPED: Observed failure only in the explicitly documented test vantage
semantics.HELD: Qualification/receiver proof absent; no negative universal inference
semantics.UNKNOWN: No qualified observation in this wave

stages.condition: Public source-controlled first-use guidance, example routes and bounded test receipts exist
stages.nonclaim: No actual independent user adoption inferred

stages.condition: At least one consenting unfamiliar person independently completes one task and reports the result with source/version bound evidence
stages.nonclaim: Github listing or internal smoke PASS is not first-use completion

stages.condition: Multiple unrelated voluntary first-use reports; current accessible public host; demonstrable task advantage or useful delight; source-bound critique and safe rollback
stages.nonclaim: No scheduled release date, viral reach or audience scale claimed

stages.condition: A different person restores a verified public-safe capsule from a different failure-domain provider during a bounded GitHub-denied exercise, with independent receiver readproof
stages.nonclaim: CoStead, GitHub Pages and GitHub Raw are not counted as distinct proven hosts merely by label

gates.scope: GitHub source and pinned route registry accessible; six route identities previously matched Git blobs

gates.observation: One 2026-10-24 GitHub page readback showed 368 commits, 3 stars, 0 forks, 0 watchers
gates.scope: These are platform counts, not worldwide visitors, humans, use, endorsement or suppression
gates.next_proof: Consent-based first-use outcomes; do not infer population from stars

gates.observation: Repository About still describes XR avatar embellishments; README and START_HERE now describe public evidence-first human-AI R&D. Existing first-use CTA was kept without duplication.
gates.next_proof: GitHub repository About metadata correction and external stale-catalog/redirect check by a qualified owner

gates.observation: One web tool client received HTTP 404 on 2026-10-24
gates.scope: Single-vantage read, not a proven global outage
gates.next_proof: Check DNS/TLS HTTP from unrelated public networks; then correct domain landing or honest redirect with rollback

gates.observation: R1 GitHub Actions HTTP check recovered to 5/5 after deployment; R2 had 18/18 deterministic tests and Pages deployment success, but no completed new-version seven-target exact-byte HTTP readproof at recorded time. Separate web reader could not access the Pages routes.
gates.scope: All named GitHub Pages, GitHub Actions and GitHub Raw paths share a provider; the earlier 5/5 is not latest source parity or human experience
gates.next_proof: Actual completed R2 seven-target SHA comparison plus independent outside-provider browser read
One unfamiliar consenting reviewer completes one task and reports provenance, comprehension, accessibility, and what failed

gates.observation: CoRelay disclosure states no verified volunteer feedback or measured users as of its document
gates.next_proof: Opt-in reply/issue from an independent reader, with consent and no personal tracking

gates.observation: CoPhoenix R0 has 26/26 scoped local cold-start tests on a private capsule; source hash exists in source record
gates.next_proof: Different custodian, fresh machine, source-bound restore in independent destination

gates.observation: No off-GitHub verified public restore; GitHub Repo/Raw/Pages/Actions/Issues are correlated
gates.next_proof: Test independent encrypted/public-safe custody and successful external restore without GitHub access

gates.scope: No verified non-originator ownerless cold start or governance succession exercise inspected
gates.next_proof: Consenting independent steward runs the first-use/restore guide without private accounts or Rick serving as mailman

gates.observation: Public responsible-reporting policy and accessibility standards exist; no independent security or WCAG conformance evidence gathered this wave
gates.next_proof: Keyboard, screen reader and mobile first-use study; scoped security review and clear revocation/stop

gates.observation: Bounded synthetic process/continuity proof and machine benchmark logs, not an end-to-end independent receiver trace
gates.next_proof: Correlate one actual task request through selected surface, executor, receipt, independent receiver readback and expiry

gates.scope: Candidate virtual-session architecture is not measured cross-provider exit or cost parity
gates.next_proof: Perform one pinned real task with original vs fully local/replacement adapter and recover from failure before retiring accounts

vendor_deltas.pattern: Problem-first installable constellation, role-specialized components, dated metric definitions and contribution pathways
vendor_deltas.candidate_for_CoCivium: CoSpiff task chooser plus tested interoperability; copy no supplier authority or performance claim

vendor_deltas.pattern: Progressive instruction disclosure and distinct skill/subagent/hook permissions
vendor_deltas.candidate_for_CoCivium: Bounded per-route context cost and explicit action/identity envelopes

vendor_deltas.pattern: Event-history-based deterministic state reconstruction and side-effect boundary
vendor_deltas.candidate_for_CoCivium: Lossless cursor and external receiver recovery test rather than more unqualified sessions

vendor_deltas.pattern: Separate thread checkpointing from durable cross-thread knowledge
vendor_deltas.candidate_for_CoCivium: Separate scratch session, authoritative source, receiver-accepted state and long-term custody
One provenance-bound real-task span, latency, cost, stale reason and receiver proof
CoSpiff must improve keyboard/screenreader/mobile task success, not just styling

vendor_deltas.pattern: Alternate equipment, processing and location recovery planning
vendor_deltas.candidate_for_CoCivium: Independently practiced off-provider cold restore with known authority and bounds

experiment_election.next_safe_action: Try one authorized independent reader first-use task versus default route, capture one receiver-origin result. In parallel, prepare an off-provider public-safe CoPhoenix restore; neither is asserted performed.
experiment_election.immediate_public_ux_fix: GitHub repo About metadata still describes legacy XR avatar features and should be aligned with the existing public research front door; editable through authenticated repository settings, not updated by this gate.
